latestVersion.changelog:
Photo Video Maker — v1.0.0

- Initial release of a cloud-based tool to turn photo collections into shareable 1080p MP4 videos within 30–60 seconds.
- Supports uploads of JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP up to 200MB; designed for social media creators.
- Simple API-driven workflow: authenticate, upload, describe your video, and download the result.
- Features credits management, session handling, and clear error messaging.
- Provides example prompts and tips for best results.
